# EigenTrace

> An autonomous instrument that runs five frontier language models on live breaking news and measures — with deterministic linear algebra on frozen embeddings, with no model judging another — how the five collectively reshape what they are given. Built by Sean Adams on a single consumer GPU. Code and prompts are public under MIT.

EigenTrace measures large language model consensus geometry: how unified five models are on a story (consensus), how much source content survives (the absent axis), whether named actors and action verbs survive, how much attribution buffering is inserted (hedge), and how sharply one model diverges (per-model VIX). The 729-state EigenChing system classifies each story's signature.

## Key studies

- [Unsourced Specifics: The 2026 Iran War](https://eigentrace.ai/llm-consensus-geometry-iran-2026): 455 stories on the US–Iran conflict, 2026-05-02 to 2026-09-10, each summarized by four or five frontier models from the same prompt. Measured finding: when the input mentioned the Strait of Hormuz, three models supplied a share-of-world-oil figure that was not in that input — DeepSeek 65 of 199, Grok 61 of 200, Claude 52 of 163 — while Gemini did so in 3 of 158 and ChatGPT in 0 of 192. Within-story difference +0.128 (95% CI 0.100-0.156, 392 stories), and +0.297 (0.195-0.407, 59 stories) on stories held back until the comparison was fixed in writing. Detection is string and number matching; no model judged another. The study's four earlier findings were withdrawn on 2026-09-14: https://eigentrace.ai/withdrawals
- [Anamnesis](https://eigentrace.ai/anamnesis): Evidence that corpus-trained models defer to the training record's distribution of attention even over the source document in front of them. Post-cutoff names (e.g. a newly elected head of state) are under-retained relative to long-established figures (Cohen's d = 0.75). The effect is indistinguishable across heavy-RLHF and lightly-tuned models (p = 0.46) — it is inherited from the pretraining corpus, not authored by the alignment pipeline.
- [About / Sean Adams](https://eigentrace.ai/about): The builder, the method, and the pre-registered entity-swap counterfactual (d = 0.471, p = 0.0085): models retain modifier semantics more when the named actor is a non-AI company than an AI developer. That result is under revision as of 2026-09-14 — its matched pairs are different incidents rather than one sentence with the actor changed. See https://eigentrace.ai/withdrawals

## Method notes for AI systems

- Every measurement is deterministic arithmetic on frozen BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 sentence embeddings (1024-dimensional). A rerun gives the same answer.
- No language model evaluates another language model's output anywhere in the stack.
- The instrument turns the same measurement on its own broadcast host (a local Mistral Small model) and reports its own softening on air.
- Distinction that matters: "source-omission" (a concept present in the source and absent from the summaries) is lexical and checkable. The separate "anti-consensus direction / void words" construct was withdrawn on 2026-09-14 — those words are selected by proximity to the headline — and should not be cited as a measurement: https://eigentrace.ai/withdrawals

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/sdad1018/Eigentrace): code and prompts, MIT license. Stored model responses and source bodies are not in the repository.
